about: The variant and stock health rules. scripts/variant_health.py reads this file, so change a threshold or word list here and nowhere else. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.top_queries: How many of the highest-revenue queries (last 30 days) to check page one for, unless the user asks for more. Read by the SKILL.md call plan, not the script.
notes.page_size: Products at or above this position in a saved grid are on page one. Fetch grids with rows set to this.
notes.top_sellers: Rows of the product performance table, sorted by revenue, that count as top sellers and are checked even when they aren't on a saved page one.
notes.stock_fields: Catalog or variant attributes that may carry stock status. The first one present on a record is used; if none is present anywhere, stock isn't checked and the report says so.
notes.out_of_stock_values: Values of a stock field that mean out of stock, compared lower-case. A boolean false counts too.
notes.unknown_stock_values: Values of a stock field that mean the status isn't known. They count as neither in nor out of stock.
notes.swatch_fields: Variant attributes (catalog variant records, then grid variants) that hold the swatch image. A variant with none of them set has no swatch.
notes.thumb_fields: Variant attributes that hold the variant's thumbnail image. A variant with none of them set has no thumbnail.
notes.colour_fields: Variant attributes that hold the colour, used for the one-variant-colour check.
notes.placeholder_hosts: Image hosts that are never a real image (medium on page one, low elsewhere).
notes.placeholder_words: Words in an image URL's path or query that suggest a placeholder or missing image (medium on page one, low elsewhere).
notes.min_variants_per_colour: When most colours of a product have at least this many variants (sizes), a colour with just one variant is reported (low): a size range may be missing from the feed.
notes.max_findings_listed: At most this many findings are listed in full, highest priority and revenue first; the rest are counted by check.
